A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

EP methods are able to provide a reliable description of binary clusters, provided that the structural and energetic properties of the pure elements are accurately reproduced, and that the electronic structure of the clusters is taken into account.
the Pd Au and Pd Pt clusters have the most cohesive core and surface, and the Ag Au and Au Pt ones have the least cohesive core and surface.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the EP method can be used to study the structural motifs of binary clusters, and the DF calculations provide a quantitative description of the relative energies of the different motifs and of the driving force for surface segregation.
the EP/DF methodology is able to provide a reliable description of the stability and composition of 38 atom binary TM clusters.

, in the size range of 38 atom clusters, the structural motif is determined by the competition between cohesive and surface energy terms, and the composition of the cluster is determined by the balance between the cohesive energy of the core and the surface energy of the shell.
